headline: THE CLAP PROOF REFUSES A LOUD ROOM
lede: The studio's ±50 ms clap gate stopped judging on contended boxes: noisy takes now SKIP by name, a strict --witness mode keeps the real proof, and the 500 ms mutant stays red through any load.

notes.text: plaicraft:clap's synth ±50 ms gate misfired on a shared box — one clap at +102.8 ms while the take's own clock proved the world paced ~100 ms off realtime. Red pair verdicts now SKIP (named, never PASS) only when the take demonstrates that drift band; any desync beyond it goes RED regardless.

New --witness flag = the strict quiet-box run QA asked for (#2654): no skips, ever. A contended witness goes red by design, so line 3 of PLAICRAFT S1 gets a real machine-side proof instead of noise — the audited phone shape (mic late −3.8 s, CPU ×8) landed every clap within ±50 ms (worst −44.4 ms, 16/16).

Strict keyed grading re-confirmed all three claptest takes in the store predate the live pair coach (0 pairs / blank / zero-taps). Line 3 needs ONE coach-live take from Jon — jonq #2652, deadline Nov 20; the nightly self-grades the night it lands.
voiceDrift sign law for the next lane: negative lag = mic opened late (the audited phone shape), positive = ticks starving. Both mean the box is contended — never confuse shape with alignment.
